Subject: Acme - Mutual Action Plan & next steps

Hi Sam —

Great speaking with you and Taylor earlier today. Quick recap and the MAP attached: acme-map-20270518.xlsx. Key points and proposed owners/dates below so we can align on responsibilities for the evaluation.

Summary from call:
- Goal: Evaluate Redwood Inference for product search reranking and assistant use cases (performance + cost).
- Success criteria: 95%+ precision improvement on rerank test and sub-300ms p95 latency for chat API.
- Timeline: 4-week evaluation window starting when MAP is signed.

Mutual Action Plan (attached):
- Week 0 (now): Sign MAP and confirm evaluation owners
  - Owner (ACME): Taylor Nguyen (technical lead)
  - Owner (Redwood): Marissa Cole (AE) + Connor O'Brien (CSM)
- Week 1: Baseline integration & sample dataset ingest
- Week 2: Run tests, iterate quant/profile settings
- Week 3: Performance tuning & docs handoff
- Week 4: Exec review & ROI discussion

Can you please confirm the ACME owners and the proposed start date? If May 24th works, we can kick off the baseline integration then and I’ll schedule a 30-min technical checkpoint for May 26th.

Open asks for you:
1) Confirm who will be the evaluation owner on your side (name & email)
2) Confirm target start date for the 4-week window
3) Any compliance/contract gating we should loop in early?

I’ll stand up a shared doc and a short runbook for the initial ingest once you confirm.

Thanks — excited to get ACME started.

—
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com | +1 415-555-0132
